messages:
maria: Quick ask — we need a short matrix of throughput/latency for A100 / H100 / L40S for the long‑seq workload (seq=8192).
Please run perfbench v2 with batch sizes 1,4,8 and dtypes fp16 + int8 (where supported). Goal: regression check against perf/2026-02-28 baseline. Only need p99 lat, tokens/sec, and peak GPU memory.

aj: I can run H100 today afternoon. Which model and exact command? also, do we want KV cache on disk or in‑mem? :thinking:

maria: thanks aj — model: gpt-neox-20b (same as baseline). KV in‑mem. Output format: csv: model,sku,bs,dtype,seq,tokens_per_sec,p99_ms,peak_mem_mb,run_tag.

ravi: I can do A100 tomorrow AM. note: for int8 on A100 we use the quantized build from ryzen/quant-int8 branch. Will that be okay?

maria: yes use ryzen/quant-int8 for int8. please add git sha in run_tag.

sasha: L40S is tricky on staging — current driver has a weird memcline with seq>4096. I can try on the partner cluster but might need to cap batch=4. I'll still run bs=1,4,8 but call out failures. :grimacing:

leo: command I used last time:```./tools/perfbench/run.sh --model gpt-neox-20b --seq 8192 --batch 4 --dtype fp16 --iters 200 --out out.csv --tag perf/2026-03-01-h100```change bs and dtype per run. Also export TF_FORCE_GPU_ALLOW_GROWTH=1 to avoid OOM spikes.

maria: perfect leo. Add --trace=nvprof or --trace=nsys for at least one run per SKU so we can profile hot kernels.

perf-bot: Allocated H100-g.4 to aj for 3h (job id: 4829).

aj: confirmed allocation. I'll run bs 1,4,8 fp16 and fp16+int8 conversion attempt (if quant build stable). Posting results as csv to /mnt/perf-results/1769991234/

ravi: queued A100 runs. quick heads up — for A100 we saw a 7% drop in tokens/sec when enabling cudnn conv tuning; will run with and without CUDNN_TUNE.

sasha: started L40S run (bs=1). got OOM at seq=8192 with bs=8 — aborting that job and retrying with bs=4. logging full nvprof for bs=4 fp16.

maria: thanks all. Action items: aj upload H100 csv + nsys for one run; ravi upload both A100 csvs (tuned/untuned); sasha upload what you can and mark failures. I'll collate and run the regression check script `tools/analysis/regress_check.py --baseline perf/2026-02-28 --input-dir /mnt/perf-results/1769991234`.

leo: pinging @ravi on the CR for perfbench change — small arg parsing fix. can you review? https://github.com/redwood/perfbench/pull/312

ravi: on it, will review in next 30m.

maria: if anyone hits flaky p99 outliers, please attach the raw nsys timeline — want to see whether it's kernel scheduling or NVLINK stalls.

perf-bot: Reminder: nightly cleanup will remove /tmp/perf-rtmp after 12h. Move traces to persistent storage.

aj: uploaded h100_runs.csv and h100_nsys.zip to /mnt/perf-results/1769991234. CSV has fields per requested format.

sasha: uploaded l40s_bs4_fp16.csv and l40s_bs8_failure.log.

ravi: uploaded a100_tuned.csv and a100_untuned.csv. added run_tag with git sha. started regression script locally; will paste summary when done.

maria: thanks — I'll run the collate + regress locally in ~15m and post results. :thumbsup:
